general.title: MOSuite - plot 2D PCA
general.instructions: Create 2D PCA plots to visualize sample relationships and clustering patterns

parameters.name: Count type
parameters.description: The type of counts to use when plotting a multiOmicDataSet.

parameters.name: Group column name
parameters.description: The column from the sample metadata containing the sample group information. This is usually a column showing to which experimental treatments each sample belongs, such as WildType, Knockout, Tumor, Normal, Before, or After.

parameters.name: Label column name
parameters.description: The column from the sample metadata containing the sample labels as you wish them to appear on the PCA plot. This can be the same Sample Names Column. You may select a different column with shorter labels for display on the figure. The selected column should contain unique names for each sample.

parameters.name: Sample ID column name
parameters.description: The column from the sample metadata containing the sample names. The names in this column must exactly match the names used as sample column names in the input counts matrix.

parameters.name: Samples to rename
parameters.description: Rename samples manually for display on the PCA plot. Use the format old_name:new_name.

parameters.name: Principal components
parameters.description: Vector with numbered principal components to plot. Use two principal components for a 2D PCA plot.

parameters.name: Feature ID column name
parameters.description: The column from the counts data containing the Feature IDs, usually Gene or Protein ID. This is usually the first column of the input counts matrix. Only columns of text type from the input counts matrix are available to select for this parameter.

parameters.name: Legend font size
parameters.description: Font size for the PCA legend text. When no value is supplied, the size is scaled automatically based on the number and length of legend labels.

parameters.name: Label font size
parameters.description: Font size for text labels on the PCA plot.

parameters.name: Label offset X
parameters.description: Horizontal offset for text labels on the PCA plot.

parameters.name: Label offset Y
parameters.description: Vertical offset for text labels on the PCA plot.

parameters.name: Log transform counts
parameters.description: Apply log(x + pseudocount) to sample count columns before PCA. Use this for count-like data such as raw, clean, filt, or CPM-like counts; leave FALSE for already normalized/log-scale or batch-corrected values to avoid double transformation.

parameters.name: Interactive plots
parameters.description: Set to TRUE to make the PCA plot interactive with plotly.

parameters.name: Color values
parameters.description: Vector of colors as hex values or names recognized by R. Unnamed colors are assigned by factor level order when the grouping column is a factor; otherwise, they follow the order in which groups first appear in the metadata column.
parameters.help_text: Use color names or hex codes. Supplied colors are used first; if there are more groups than colors, additional colors are generated from the MOSuite palette, with random colors only if that palette is too short.
